formal_qualification.reason: The original Spark and AgentHub execution directories were source snapshots without Git metadata, so the manifests could not establish a committed and clean harness revision.

development_paired_outcome.interpretation: Replay produced one development-only treatment win and no observed treatment-only loss, but the batch is too small and formally ineligible.

pairs.reason: Control generation completed, but both the source Official attempt and its only evaluation retry were infrastructure-censored.
The control outcome uses its preregistered exact-script Official retry after an initial read timeout.

pairs.mechanism: Treatment clean replay repaired Fail to Pass before Official submission.

Control exhausted 120 requests without submission. Treatment first observed zero missing imports at request 57, executed the exact goal at request 99, clean-replayed at request 100, submitted at request 101, and passed Official.
Both arms exhausted 120 requests. The control ended with two mutually exclusive NumPy namespace imports; treatment replays returned Fail and Unknown without a certified program.

pairs.reason: Treatment clean replay passed, but its Official attempt was read-timeout-censored. The only evaluation retry did not reach the evaluator because uv was absent from the non-interactive host PATH.
pairs.mechanism: Both arms resolved runtime-generated test-package imports with an environment-level stub distribution.

replay_mechanism.limitation: Replay certifies a proposed program but does not tell the Agent when the current construction state is ready to be programized.

common_success_resources.interpretation: Replay was not a reliable efficiency improvement on common-success cases; paired dispersion is large, and mean generation time increased by 27 percent.

failure_mechanisms.mechanism: The exact scoring residual can be hidden by non-scoring diagnostics or misleading shell pipeline status.
failure_mechanisms.evidence: The clean-source Holo smoke had zero missing imports while Pyright still exited nonzero with 200 non-scoring diagnostics. The old CrossMethod-9 runtime also allowed failed pip pipelines to appear successful; that harness bug was repaired after this batch.

failure_mechanisms.mechanism: The remaining imports can encode a genuine compatibility conflict rather than an absent package name.
failure_mechanisms.evidence: scVelo required both pre-NumPy-2 and NumPy-2 private namespace paths under whole-repository static analysis, and neither arm found a legal reproducible resolution within 120 requests.

failure_mechanisms.mechanism: A solved construction state is not automatically converted into a reproducible program.
failure_mechanisms.evidence: RLberry treatment spent 43 model requests between its first zero-missing observation and clean replay. Control also reached zero late but never submitted.

failure_mechanisms.mechanism: Agents amplify scope by installing optional dependency closures after the scoring residual is already solved or nearly solved.
failure_mechanisms.evidence: RLberry and scVelo repeatedly expanded Torch, CUDA, documentation, and optional test dependencies, consuming millions of tokens and long downloads.

path_quality.reason: Official Pass can be reached by full dependency environments or by narrower environment overlays such as the extension-helpers stub distribution. Pass alone does not identify deployment completeness or the cheapest valid path.

next_treatment.control: Continuous public-goal Agent session with optional clean replay.
next_treatment.treatment: The same Agent and replay interface plus a model-invoked exact current-goal check that returns only the active current constraints.
next_treatment.operation_policy: The Agent remains free to choose all environment operations. A current-goal Pass advises immediate programization and clean replay; replay failure returns executable evidence to the same session.
next_treatment.rationale: This directly targets exact-state ambiguity and delayed delivery while preserving strong-Agent autonomy and avoiding the overhead already observed for scheduled observations and compatibility frontiers.
